registeredWritePathDefinition.statement: A registered write path is a compute unit that, given real input, decides whether a parcel-record rail (or Factory writer job) cell resolves to a value on some branch. One test per unit, asserting a real input reaches a non-declined/non-null/non-skip outcome. This mirrors computeTier1Envelope's own shape: a pure decision function, called by a CLI/job, that is or is not structurally capable of a positive outcome.
